name: TGorillaVolumetricNoise
definition: A subclass of TGorillaVolumetricMesh that fills its own 3D texture with fractal (FBM) Perlin noise and renders it as a physically based emission-absorption medium.
summary: TGorillaVolumetricNoise generates 3D fractal noise for volumetric media, distinguishing itself by baking a smooth density gradient and applying opacity via Beer-Lambert absorption to eliminate terracing artifacts.
